_readme: THIS APP'S DONE-RECORD — [pipeline N-2] Private/requirements/ (was pipeline/06-app-build.md, folded into the JSON spec 2026-08-15)
Stamped with the app. It answers 'is this app done?' as a QUERY rather than a memory, and
tooling/ci/assert-app-dod.mjs fails the build on it. The right-hand side of every set comparison
below is tooling/dod-register.json — the DoD items, and the four human-review rows.
IT IS AN OUTPUT, NEVER AN INPUT. 39-CHASSIS §4 cut 4 stands: mason vars are the stamp's only
input contract. This file describes VERIFICATION STATE; it never feeds the stamp.
status:
stamped        a fresh stamp. Shape + the mechanical rows are enforced; the human verdicts and
the selection gates are recorded as pending, and their blanks do not fail.
claiming-done  everything is enforced. An app the public catalogue advertises as 'live' while
this still says 'stamped' FAILS THE BUILD — that cross-check is what stops
'stamped' becoming a permanent excuse.
features: the six the CHASSIS itself ships, so a freshly stamped app carries six REAL rows
rather than `features: []`. An app adds its own here as it builds them. Each row's `test` must
resolve to a real declaration with a non-empty body, `effect` must still name a symbol that is
there, and `mutation.date` EXPIRES: change the implementation and the row goes red until the
mutation is re-run and the date moved. That is the difference between an event and a state.
🔴 EVERY MUTATION BELOW WAS ACTUALLY RUN, on a real mason stamp, with `flutter test`, and the
named test was observed RED. Two candidate rows were REJECTED at that step rather than recorded:
a `themeMode` row whose mutation the suite did not notice, and an account-deletion row whose test
drives the seam in packages/auth_supabase rather than anything under this app — an effect anchor
outside the app cannot be re-dated against the app's own history. Account deletion is covered
instead by the chassis property `account-deletion-works`, which carries six anchors of its own.
A row whose mutation nobody watched is exactly the 'proven once in a terminal' claim this field
exists to replace.
🔄 2026-08-08 — THE EIGHT SUBLY PRODUCT ROWS BELOW WERE RUN AGAINST apps/subly ITSELF, not
against a mason stamp: they are THIS app's features (home · calendar · insights · budget · scan ·
detail · add-sheet · cancel-sheet), so a stamp has nothing to say about them. Same discipline as
the six chassis rows above — each mutation was applied to the real tree, `flutter analyze` was
run and stayed at the tree's standing 29 infos with ZERO errors and ZERO warnings (so the red is
an ASSERTION and not a compile error), the named test was observed red through its own `expect`,
and the file was restored. The `sign out` row's date moved for the same reason its clause exists:
lib/core/router.dart changed after 2026-08-02, so the record described code that had moved.
🔄 2026-08-10 (UTC) — SEVEN ROWS RE-RUN AND RE-DATED, not one. The auth/router work of
2026-08-09..10 moved six implementation files under apps/subly/lib, and every mutation record
anchored to one of them expired at once: sign out · finish onboarding · edit profile · consent
prompt · dark mode · home · budget. `apps/subly/dod-flip-draft.json` measured ONE stale row on
2026-08-09 (`edit profile`) and its checklist step 1 was written for that one; the count was true
when measured and false by the time it merged. THE COUNT WAS NEVER THE POINT — the expiry clause
does not care how many rows it takes down, and a record that says `1` where the tree says `7` is
the same failure as a record that says `done` where the tree says `stamped`.
Each of the seven was re-earned the way the six above were: the mutation named in `mutation.symbol`
was applied to the REAL tree (never a fixture), `flutter analyze` was run and held at the tree's
standing 28 infos with ZERO errors and ZERO warnings — so the red is an ASSERTION and not a compile
error — the named test was observed red through its own `expect`, and the file was restored to
byte-identical. The failing assertion is quoted verbatim in each row's `note`. Suite before and
after: 492 passed, 0 failed.
⚠️ THIS RECORD IS NOT YET GRADED. assert-app-dod.mjs EXEMPTs `apps/subly` by name
(39-CHASSIS §4 cut 1), so nothing below can fail a build today. Two things are true at once and
the flip has to handle both in ONE commit: catalog/apps.json already advertises this
app as `"status": "live"`, so dropping the exemption while this file still says `stamped` turns
the lifecycle anchor red on the first push — which is the anchor working, not a defect.

A.note: SUBLY'S OWN ROUTES, not the chassis register: tooling/screen-register.json holds 23 chassis screens and ZERO apps/subly anchors, so it is not this app's evidence. What is: lib/core/router.dart declares 15 GoRoutes, and chassis_properties_test.dart's 'every tap target on every declared route is at least 48px' VISITS every one of them plus the errorBuilder and asserts visited.length == routes.paths.length + errorBuilder — a RELATIONSHIP, so the only way to shrink the domain is to delete a route from the router itself

B.note: human — the four-states verdict per data screen, recorded in humanReview. WHAT THE REVIEWER WILL FIND, so the verdict is not a surprise: home is the only data screen with three distinct branches (subscriptionsControllerProvider.when → spinner / 'Could not load: $e' / dashboard). calendar, insights and detail all collapse loading AND error into `valueOrNull ?? const []`, so a FAILED fetch renders as the empty state ('No renewals this month.' · 'Nothing flagged — nice.' · 'Subscription not found') and is indistinguishable from having no data. budget renders a bare Center(CircularProgressIndicator) with no error branch at all. No screen distinguishes offline from error. The sheets are the exception and were fixed: sheet_failure_surface_test.dart drives both failure paths

C.note: assert-stamp-properties.mjs EXEMPTs apps/subly by name (EXEMPT_APPS), so the five-class pin runs HERE, in this app's own suite: chassis_properties_test.dart's 'five window classes, at Material 600/840/1200/1600' on the pure resolver, and 'the scaffold really switches control at the 600 boundary' pumping AppScaffold across it. Per-screen width is now measured on the ROUTED SET, not three screens: responsive_width_test.dart (onboarding · settings · manage-plan) plus seven per-screen suites — width_calendar · width_budget · width_insights · width_scan · width_detail · width_add_sheet · width_cancel_sheet — at 375/768/1280(/1920), each with a stated falsifiable case. ⬜ ONE GAP: HomeScreen's ContentPane has no width group (home_screen.dart's own comment says so), so that one wrapper can still be deleted with every test green

D.note: both limbs run in this app's own suite: 'the app supplies theme, darkTheme AND themeMode' + 'light and dark are genuinely different schemes' (the triplet), and 'a choice is written to storage' + 'a stored choice SURVIVES a restart' + 'NULL means follow the device, and is the default' (the write AND the read-back — a choice saved and never restored looks exactly like no persistence). PLUS the limb the chassis property does not own: dark_card_surface_test.dart pins cardDecoration, the single decoration behind 17 call sites across five screens, in BOTH brightnesses — light asserted against the literal token so a 'tidy-up' to scheme.surface cannot pass, dark asserted against the scheme. Negative-tested 2026-08-08 by reverting the decoration

E.note: 🔄 THE MECHANICAL HALF REACHES THIS APP FROM 2026-08-11. assert-no-hardcoded-strings.mjs enforced the BRICK TEMPLATE only, and apps/subly/lib had been in its CANARY list (kept because it was known-DIRTY, 59 hits) until 2026-08-08 — between those dates no guard counted literals here, and this note said so. The retrofit then emptied the tree: the same matchers now measure FIVE hits, every one a data interpolation ('${s.category} · $usage'), which the guard exempts as a class because there is no prose in them to translate. apps/subly/lib is an ENFORCED root now, with ONE named allowlist entry — login_screen.dart's 'debug: $detail', a kDebugMode-only E2E notice the tree-shaker removes from every release artifact. A new English literal in a Subly screen fails the build. WHAT WAS ALREADY REAL: two locales genuinely ship and are genuinely exercised — l10n_parity_test.dart asserts key parity in BOTH directions, placeholder parity in both directions (no dropped and no invented placeholder) and that the plural key really pluralizes, and 'the running app renders the chosen locale' + 'the same key yields DIFFERENT text in each locale' drive the seam

F.note: the three mechanical WCAG limbs run in this app's own suite, over this app's own routes: 'text scaling is clamped to 1.0–2.0 at the app root' (read INSIDE the app below the clamp, not off the dispatcher), 'every tap target on every declared route is at least 48px' (all 15 GoRoutes + the errorBuilder, with a non-empty-domain floor so a pump that rendered nothing cannot report clean), and 'every icon-only control carries a screen-reader label'. The manual screen-reader pass stays a recorded cut (no Apple device) — a11y debt, not a gate. 🔴 2026-08-25 — APPENDED, AND IT IS THE HALF THIS ROW WAS SILENT ABOUT. Between 2026-08-21 and today this row read 'held' while SC 2.1.1 Keyboard (Level A) was MEASURED AND FAILING on this app: 55 controls swept across login, settings and home, 30 reachable by Tab, and login's sign-up toggle — the only control that reaches registration from the screen every signed-out visitor is routed to — among the unreachable ones. The three limbs named above are all true and none of them can see that: text-scale, 48px tap targets and icon labels are about SIZE and about what a SCREEN READER hears, and a control can pass all three while no key press can land on it. A 'held' beside three limbs that cannot see a fourth failure is exactly the shape tooling/dod-register.json's `insideTheClaim` list was added to stop. RE-MEASURED TODAY after packages/design_system's `FocusableTap` replaced the hand-rolled `Semantics` + `GestureDetector` pairs on those three screens: login 8 of 8, settings 25 of 27, home 20 of 20 — 53 of 55 reachable by Tab, and the 2 that are not are the `en`/`ta` members of the language `RadioGroup`, which is ONE Tab stop by design and moves on the arrow keys (asserted separately, and the 2026-08-21 sweep's reading of those two as dead was wrong — the honest failing count that day was 23, not 25). ⚠️ WHAT THIS ROW STILL DOES NOT SAY, DELIBERATELY: that this app conforms to WCAG 2.2 Level AA. THREE screens were swept — login, settings, home. lib/core/router.dart declares 19 `GoRoute`s today, two of them redirects, so 17 build a screen (MEASURED 2026-08-25 by `grep -c 'GoRoute('`; item A above still says 15, which is a separate drift and not this row's to repair). Fourteen screens are therefore UNMEASURED for 2.1.1, and no contrast ratio has been measured for the focus indicator the fix introduces (SC 2.4.7 / 2.4.11 carry no row anywhere in the register). The published wording lives in tooling/dod-register.json `claimWording.claimText`, not here, and whether it moves is the owner's call — recorded there as owed. This row asserts the three mechanical limbs it names and nothing above them

G.note: assert-launcher-icons.mjs DOES cover this app — it walks apps/, and apps/subly is the one app in the tree with native platforms. Measured on this repo: 33 native icons compared against stock resolved by RUNNING `flutter create` with the live SDK (never pinned hashes, so the comparison cannot go stale), 21 iOS icons checked for the ITMS-90717 alpha channel, 1 adaptive-icon manifest, and 5 Linux packaging artefacts RE-DERIVED from this app's own 1024 master and compared as decoded pixels — that last limb is satisfied only by Subly's own mark, where 'not identical to Flutter's' is satisfied by a blank square. ⬜ assert-stamp-brand-assets.mjs runs as `apps/probe` only, so the seed-colour limb is NOT asserted for this app

H.note: the `app_brick` lane proves this for a freshly STAMPED app, not for this one. What covers apps/subly is the `workspace_gate` lane: `melos run analyze` + `melos run test` across every workspace member in ONE resolution, and apps/subly is the workspace's only app member — so this app analyzes clean and runs its own suite on every push, in a job inside ci-gate's `needs:`. Measured 2026-08-08 on this tree: `flutter analyze` = 29 issues, all `info`, zero errors and zero warnings; `flutter test` = 245 passed. The per-feature effect proof is the `features` block below

features.name: sign in
features.primaryAction: submitting the sign-in form authenticates and moves the user off it
features.test: signing in through the FORM moves the user off it
features.note: 🔴 RE-POINTED 2026-08-10, and it was ALREADY WRONG before `/sign-in` became canonical. This row named `sign_in_screen.dart` — the stamped twin — while the test it cites drives the LIVE `LoginScreen` through `E2EKeys.loginSubmit` (chassis_properties_test.dart says so in as many words: the union's signed-out form is the live LoginScreen, whose submit is a GradientButton, not the stamp's FilledButton). So the anchor pointed at an implementation the named test never executed, and deleting that file would not have reddened anything — the exact hollow-anchor shape N-5 exists to prevent. The stamped twin has since been removed with the route consolidation, which is what forced the row to be read rather than inherited. RE-EARNED, not re-labelled: the mutation below was run against the real tree on the day it is dated.

mutation.observedRed: signing in through the FORM moves the user off it

features.name: sign out
features.primaryAction: ending the session puts the user back on the sign-in form
features.test: signing out puts the user back on the form
features.note: 🔄 RE-RUN 2026-08-10 (UTC): router.dart moved with the /sign-in canonicalisation, so the 2026-08-08 record described a file that had changed. Deleting the `refreshListenable:` line left the sign-out redirect with nothing to fire on, and chassis_properties_test.dart:1651 went red — 'Expected: at least one matching candidate / Actual: _TypeWidgetFinder:<Found 0 widgets with type "TextField": []>', reason 'the session ended and the user was left inside the app'.

mutation.observedRed: signing out puts the user back on the form

features.name: finish onboarding
features.primaryAction: the last onboarding step records the choice and first run does not come back
features.test: finishing it moves the user on, and it does not come back
features.note: 🔄 RE-RUN 2026-08-10 (UTC). Flipping the recorded value to `set(false)` — rather than deleting the write, which would have left the provider import unused and turned the red into an analyzer finding — sends the router's gate straight back to the carousel. chassis_properties_test.dart:2178 went red: 'Which: means one was found but none were expected', reason 'skipping left the user exactly where they were'.

mutation.observedRed: finishing it moves the user on, and it does not come back

features.name: edit profile
features.primaryAction: saving a display name reaches the identity seam and the UI shows the new value
features.test: editing it in the REAL app updates what the user sees
features.note: 🔄 RE-RUN 2026-08-10 (UTC). This is the row dod-flip-draft.json's checklist step 1 was written for, and it was the only one that file measured; six others had expired with it. Deleting the `updateProfile` call from `_saveProfile` leaves the Save button popping its own dialog and nothing else — chassis_properties_test.dart:2059 went red with the reason it was written for: 'the name was typed and saved and the screen still shows the old value — which is what a save button wired to nothing looks like'.

mutation.observedRed: editing it in the REAL app updates what the user sees

features.name: consent prompt
features.primaryAction: the app root asks for analytics consent and Allow really opens the rail
features.test: the app root asks for consent, and Allow opens the rail
features.note: 🔄 RE-RUN 2026-08-10 (UTC): app.dart moved when the dead dialog-shaped ConsentGate was deleted. UNMOUNTING the gate — not deleting the class, which would only have been a compile error — is the mutation that matters, because the retired ConsentGate is exactly the widget that went on compiling and passing its tests after it stopped being mounted. chassis_properties_test.dart:3503 went red: reason 'no consent prompt in the app root ⇒ nothing ever calls ConsentController.record ⇒ every event is silently discarded'.

mutation.observedRed: the app root asks for consent, and Allow opens the rail

features.name: dark mode
features.primaryAction: the dark theme is a genuinely dark scheme, not the light one under another name
features.test: light and dark are genuinely different schemes
features.note: 🔄 RE-RUN 2026-08-10 (UTC), same file and same cause as the consent row. Flipping the seed's brightness to `Brightness.light` makes darkTheme the light one under another name — the whole property — and chassis_properties_test.dart:1038 went red on the values themselves: 'Expected: Brightness:<Brightness.dark> / Actual: Brightness:<Brightness.light>'.

mutation.observedRed: light and dark are genuinely different schemes

features.name: home
features.primaryAction: the app lands on the dashboard and its header renders the product, with the localised welcome as the signed-out fallback
features.test: home body renders the product with the welcome fallback
features.note: 🔄 RE-RUN 2026-08-10 (UTC). Replacing the signed-out fallback with an empty string leaves the header rendering nothing where the product name belongs, and smoke_test.dart:82 went red: 'Actual: _TextContainingWidgetFinder:<Found 0 widgets with text containing Welcome to: []>'.

features.primaryAction: the budget screen resolves the budget through the repository and renders the ring plus a bar per category, rather than sitting on its spinner
features.test: at 1920 the list stops at AppBreakpoints.kMaxBodyWidth
features.note: 🔄 RE-RUN 2026-08-10 (UTC). The provider was made to return a future that never completes (`Completer<BudgetInfo>().future`), which is what 'sitting on its spinner' looks like from the widget tree — the repository watch was KEPT so the mutation costs no analyzer finding, and a first attempt that dropped it added a real `unused_import` warning, which would have made the red ambiguous. width_budget_test.dart:81 went red one step before the width assertion: 'Actual: _TypeWidgetFinder:<Found 0 widgets with type "ContentPane": []>', reason 'this screen has no ContentPane at all, so there is no width cap to measure'.

mutation.observedRed: at 1920 the list stops at AppBreakpoints.kMaxBodyWidth

humanReview.asks: loading (skeleton), empty (illustration+CTA), error (message+Retry) and offline are FOUR visually distinct outcomes on every data screen
at least one interactive feature beyond viewing content. UNVERIFIED: the applicable Apple clause is carried as 4.2.2 from 00-STAGE-3-14-RESEARCH.md, not read from developer.apple.com

first value arrives fast and the paywall sits AFTER the value moment. A judgment, never a threshold a guard may assert — the '60 seconds' in master-requirements §2.4 is a target with no measurement method
brand icon and splash applied, motion tokens, skeletons not spinners, friendly empty/error states
